title: TopologySemanticContextResolveContext
description: Optional runtime artifact or workbench session context used when resolving topology semantic context.

artifactId.description: Chat artifact id being acted on. Used as the scoped context id when supplied.

overlayRevision.description: Overlay revision observed by the caller when context is requested.

sessionId.description: Visibility session id when resolving context for a topology workbench session.

sessionRevision.description: Session revision observed by the caller when context is requested.

proposalId.description: Proposal id currently being previewed or applied when the caller has one.
